bidirectional_decomposition.note: Per CCL-027 — bidirectional cancellation guard. Xu-538 CpGs split by direction of (β_tumor − β_normal) majority across QC-passed patients. Lymphoid vs myeloid lineage assignment NOT applied here; that is deferred to immune-atlas card per OQ-2026-01. The split here is direction-of-shift, not lineage.
bidirectional_decomposition.interpretation: When the bidirectional split is applied, the combined absolute magnitude reveals the TRUE departure from healthy-immune baseline. The pooled-entropy A-score under-represents this magnitude because positive and negative direction CpGs partially cancel. This is exactly the AD-template cancellation pattern CCL-027 flagged for every card to check.
